title_zh: 确认业余乐团恢复排练的安排

scenario.label_zh: 恢复业余乐团并确认首次排练安排
scenario.goal_zh: 确认恢复排练所需场地已有答复并约定通知成员首次排练时间

context_zh: 社区业余乐团组织者 Hana 与 Tom 在停办后筹备恢复活动。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: There's real enthusiasm for a revival of the neighbourhood orchestra.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Yes, but to revive it we need more than interested messages. Have we secured a rehearsal room?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: The hall has confirmed our booking for Saturday at ten.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Then we can resume rehearsals with a short first session rather than promise a concert straight away.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: I'll tell the players the time and ask them to bring the music we already have.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.text: Good. I'll prepare a simple rehearsal plan for that first morning.

targets.sense_zh: 使恢复活力或重新开展
